title: Coordinated release-train schedule & cross-team launch calendar
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Coordinate a centralized launch calendar and release-train cadence across Runtime, Console, and API teams to enable predictable monthly releases. Deliverables: single shared calendar, per-team cutover windows, inter-team rollback/fallback playbooks, gating criteria for canary vs full rollout, and automated dashboard for launch readiness. Goal: reduce cross-team launch conflicts by 90% and improve time-to-detect regressions during rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Shared launch calendar published and synced to team calendars
Per-team cutover windows and blackout periods documented
Gating checklist automated (tests, metrics, infra health) and visible in Console readiness dashboard
Rollback and fallback runbook validated in a tabletop exercise
All dependent teams have nominated launch owners and have signed off on schedule
